# Indeed.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/indeed-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/indeed-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects job listing data from Indeed.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Indeed.com (2025 Update)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-indeedcom)
- **Code:** [`indeed.py`](indeed.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Job pages](results/jobs.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Indeed job search for finding job listings
- Indeed job pages for job listing datasets

## Functions

- `scrape_search(url, max_results=1000)` → `List[Dict]`: Scrape Indeed.com search for job listing previews
- `scrape_jobs(job_keys)`: scrape job page

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import indeed


async def main():
    search = await indeed.scrape_search("https://www.indeed.com/jobs?q=python&l=Texas", max_results=10)
    jobs = await indeed.scrape_jobs(["851525cd1dc01964", "0e633abc66767644"])


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`indeed.py`](indeed.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/indeed-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_search_scraping`, `test_job_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
